name: EPIC-Bench
summary: 面向定位、导航感知和操作感知的细粒度具身视觉掩码定位基准。
summaryEn: A fine-grained mask-grounding benchmark for localization, navigation-oriented perception, and manipulation-oriented perception.
scale: About 35K annotation files across 3 categories and 23 task types
scaleZh: 约 3.5 万个标注文件，覆盖 3 类、23 种任务
licenseZh: 代码采用 Apache-2.0；数据许可见发布页
access: Dataset available on Hugging Face and ModelScope
accessZh: 数据集已在 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope 提供
verdict: 细粒度测量具身场景中目标空间落地能力的开放基准
verdictEn: An open benchmark for fine-grained target grounding in embodied scenes
wmNote: 像素级目标状态可用于诊断空间世界表征和行动前感知。
wmNoteEn: Pixel-level target state diagnoses spatial world representations and pre-action perception.
